data.name: Dream Riders
data.detailed_description:
Dream Riders is a fast-paced 2.5D auto runner driving sim set in a hand-drawn dreampop pixel world. Take on a series of high-speed boss encounters each lurking behind a themed high difficulty track, or just get out and drive to see how far you can get.  Prove that nothing is off limits if you're fast enough!

Take To The Streets

The world in our near future feels…empty.

Underpopulated cities stay lit with a power grid outliving its use, but don't let the pretty lights fool you; this place died a long time ago. People hide away inside, plugged into their own virtual utopias. Outside in the streets, predatory gangs roam free alongside maintenance robots still completing their long-irrelevant tasks. The easy choice is to join the silent masses and wither away in the dark.

But the Dream Riders take to the streets!

Speed through downtown and turn this disturbia into your stomping ground — dodge the bots, duck the caution tape, and destroy the ghosts that haunt the city at night.

Boss Fights

Among the dangerous gangs roaming the streets are five factions, each helmed by an elite biker. Instead of shrinking away from the threat, the Dream Riders prove that nothing is off limits by challenging them on their own turf. Race through a series of five themed courses to face the bosses head-on and run them off the road. These courses are the ultimate test of skill, so don't give up after your first (or second, or third…) crash!

Endless Drive

How far will you make it on the Midnight Road? Test your reflexes and endurance on an endless procedurally generated road full of obstacles! With all punch and no brakes, your bike accelerates even as the difficulty ramps up over time. Challenge yourself against your personal best, compete for a top spot on the online leaderboard, or form a crew of friends to see who's fastest! And don't worry—even when you crash, you'll unlock key story moments and groovy new driving tunes as you piece together the world of the Dream Riders.

The Dream Riders

Aura, Iris, and Nyx carved their own place from a world that would brand them outcasts. Tune into their idle banter in the Garage to learn more about them and the world they live in, or go for a drive on the Midnight Road to get a peek into each of their lives—who is Iris, what does Nyx want, and what does Aura do in the precious time between crashing and making it back home?
